spec.dayTypeDefinition: efficiency ratio of a TX day session: ER = |last close - first open| / sum of absolute 5m price steps (open -> each 5m close). Trend day = top third of ER over all sample days, range day = bottom third.
preOpenPredictors: |day open - prior day close| / prior day range
daily MA squeeze (TWII MA5/10/20/60 spread / ATR14, prior day)
spec.maSqueeze: spread = (max - min of MA5, MA10, MA20, MA60 of closes) / ATR14; squeeze when spread <= 20th percentile of the previous 250 values; expansion event = close above all four MAs (long) or below all four (short) while any of the previous 3 bars was in squeeze; one event per squeeze episode (first breakout)

squeezeData.hourly: TX 60m bars (official archive, day+night), forward 10 bars

spec.squeezeOutcome: direction-signed forward move in ATR units (no costs, descriptive move size); control = all days/bars that are not squeeze events, signed by a random direction with the same long share as the events (5000 bootstrap draws by calendar year for daily, by month for hourly); also unsigned |move| vs all bars

primary.P1: pre-open: the largest |Spearman rho| among the 6 predictors vs day ER; p from 2000 max-statistic permutations
primary.P2: intraday: Spearman rho between ER of the first 12 bars (to 09:45) and ER of the rest of the day; one-sided p (rho > 0) from 2000 permutations
primary.P3: daily TWII squeeze breakout: mean signed forward-20-day move (ATR units) minus control; one-sided bootstrap p
primary.P4: hourly TX squeeze breakout: mean signed forward-10-bar move (ATR units) minus control; one-sided bootstrap p

spec.inference: Holm across P1-P4; pass = adjusted p < 0.05 with the stated sign
secondary: trend-day hit rate when a predictor is in its top third (base rate 33%)
direction continuation: sign(first 30/60 min move) vs sign(rest of day)
squeeze breakout unsigned move size vs all bars (does a squeeze lead to a bigger move, in either direction)
non-squeeze breakouts (close above/below all MAs) for comparison
spec.data: official TAIFEX 5m archive 2026-01-02..2026-11-06 (holdout already used in V6/V7); TWII daily from Yahoo

priorKnowledge: V4 notes already showed first-hour ER vs rest rho -0.03 and night range vs ER 0.04 on Jan-Aug; this run re-tests on Jan-Nov with a fixed design
